rows.label: State oversight
rows.value: North Dakota Office of State Tax Commissioner (state supervisor of assessments) and the State Board of Equalization
rows.note: The State Board of Equalization equalizes local assessments and values centrally assessed property such as railroads, pipelines and utilities.

source.title: North Dakota Office of State Tax Commissioner: State Board of Equalization

rows.label: Residential taxable value
rows.note: Taxable value of residential property is 4.5% of true and full value; local mills are applied to taxable value.

source.title: North Dakota Office of State Tax Commissioner: Residential Property Tax

rows.label: Primary Residence Credit
rows.note: State-funded credit against property tax on an owner-occupied primary home; apply each year January 1 to April 1. No age or income limits.

sections.title: North Dakota real estate transfer tax

rows.label: Real estate transfer tax
rows.value: None: the North Dakota Constitution bars the State and local governments from taxing the transfer or mortgage of real property
rows.note: Article X, Section 27 also prohibits mortgage taxes.
